description: Install dependencies for backend and frontend, install Playwright browsers, and verify the existing test suites run successfully as a baseline before adding new tests.
steps: Install backend Python dependencies: pip install -r apps/backend/requirements.txt and the dev deps (pytest, httpx, etc.)
Install frontend Node dependencies: cd apps/frontend && pnpm install
Install Playwright browsers: cd apps/frontend && npx playwright install chromium --with-deps
Run a subset of existing backend tests to verify baseline: cd apps/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_auth.py tests/test_anon_access.py -x --timeout=30
Run existing frontend e2e tests to verify Playwright baseline: cd apps/frontend && npx playwright test e2e/navigation.spec.ts --reporter=list
acceptance_criteria: Backend pytest runs without import errors on at least the auth test file
Frontend Playwright executes at least one e2e test spec successfully
All dependencies are installed without errors
